### 1. Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the real-world problem faced by small businesses (MSMEs), freelancers, or communities that motivates this request.  
*(e.g., "Vendors struggle to track multi-day rental reservations efficiently...")*

### 2. Proposed Solution
Describe the module, feature, or interface improvement you would like to see implemented.

### 3. Alternatives Considered
Have you considered or tried any alternative workarounds or tools? Why were they not ideal?

### 4. Digital Public Goods (DPG) Alignment
Please verify that this requested feature aligns with core project principles:
- [ ] Free from mandatory commercial third-party services (*No vendor lock-in*)
- [ ] Strictly adheres to zero tracking and user data privacy (*Zero Telemetry*)
- [ ] Lightweight, resource-efficient, and runs smoothly on low-spec hardware
- [ ] Inclusive and easy to use without writing code (*No-code / User-friendly*)

### 5. Additional Context / Wireframes
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or interface sketches here.
